packages.name: OpenMRS & Bahmni setup pack
packages.summary: Setup guide, verification script and the CDS bridge for the existing openmrs-module-cdss.
packages.install: Unzip on a host that can reach OpenMRS, start the bridge with docker compose, set cdss.enable and cdss.fhir.baseurl, then run ./verify.sh.

packages.name: OpenEMR module
packages.summary: PHP module that adds a VedaMD decision-support card to the patient dashboard.
packages.install: Unzip into interface/modules/custom_modules/ (keeps the oe-module-vedamd-cds folder name), then Administration → Modules → Manage Modules → Register, Install, Enable.

packages.name: Frappe Health app
packages.summary: Frappe app that checks prescriptions when a Patient Encounter is saved.
packages.install: Unzip into frappe-bench/apps/, then bench pip install -e apps/vedamd_cds, add vedamd_cds to sites/apps.txt, and bench --site <site> install-app vedamd_cds.

packages.name: GNU Health module
packages.summary: Tryton module that checks GNU Health prescriptions as they are created.
packages.install: Unzip into trytond/modules/ (keeps the vedamd_cds folder name), then trytond-admin -d <db> -u vedamd_cds --activate-dependencies.

packages.name: DHIS2 app
packages.summary: Installable DHIS2 app (no build step) that runs safety checks on Tracker records via the bridge.
packages.install: Upload this zip unchanged in App Management → Install App. Deploy the CDS bridge with BRIDGE_ALLOWED_ORIGINS set to your DHIS2 URL, then open the app and save Settings.

packages.name: CDS bridge
packages.summary: Dependency-free Node service that injects your API key for EMRs that cannot send one.
packages.install: Unzip, copy .env.example to .env and set VEDAMD_API_KEY, then docker compose up -d --build.

packages.name: Epic & Oracle Health onboarding pack
packages.summary: Prefetch templates, a sample order-select payload and a test script for native CDS Hooks.
packages.install: Set VEDAMD_API_KEY and run ./test-request.sh to prove the integration, then start vendor onboarding with the prefetch templates.
